query: Obtain a new datacenter proxy that allows connections from the IP address 192.168.1.1 and is located in the USA.

tools.name: words
tools.description: Generates and returns random words based on specified criteria using the Jibber-Jabber API.

minimumwordlength.description: Minimum length of the words to generate. Defaults to None.

maximumwordlength.description: Maximum length of the words to generate. Defaults to None.

numberofwords.description: Number of words to generate. Defaults to None.

wordlength.description: Minimum length of the words to generate. Defaults to None.

tools.name: obtain_a_new_datacenter_proxy
tools.description: Obtain a new datacenter proxy using the provided API key. The proxy will only allow connections from a specified IP address or a list of countries.

whitelist_ip.description: The IP address to whitelist for using the proxy. Allows an additional IP address besides the one making the API call.

countries.description: A comma-separated list of country codes from which the proxy should be obtained. If not specified, the country is selected randomly.

tools.name: sentences
tools.description: Fetches random sentences based on the specified constraints using the Jibber-Jabber API.

maximumnumberofsentences.description: The maximum number of sentences to retrieve. Defaults to None.

minimumwordlength.description: The minimum length of words in the sentences. Defaults to None.

minimumnumberofsentences.description: The minimum number of sentences to retrieve. Defaults to None.

numberofsentences.description: The maximum number of sentences to retrieve. Defaults to None.

maximumnumberofwords.description: The maximum number of words per sentence. Defaults to None.

minimumnumberofwords.description: The minimum number of words per sentence. Defaults to None.

numberofwords.description: The maximum number of words per sentence. Defaults to None.

wordlength.description: The minimum length of words in the sentences. Defaults to None.

maximumwordlength.description: The maximum length of words in the sentences. Defaults to None.

tools.name: rgb_to_hsl
tools.description: Converts RGB color values to HSL color values using the RapidAPI service.

r.description: Red component of the RGB color (0-255).

g.description: Green component of the RGB color (0-255).

b.description: Blue component of the RGB color (0-255).

query: Retrieve the lexical field for the word 'happiness' with a limit of 10 results.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Fetches search results from the YouTube V3 Lite API based on specified criteria.

part.description: The part parameter specifies a comma-separated list of one or more search resource properties.

x_cachebypass.description: Bypasses the cache if set to '1'. Defaults to None.

videoduration.description: The video duration. Options are 'any', 'short', 'medium', 'long'. Defaults to 'any'.

videodefinition.description: The video quality definition. Options are 'any', 'high'. Defaults to 'any'.

videocaption.description: The video captions. Options are 'any', 'closedCaption'. Defaults to 'any'.

videolicense.description: The video license. Options are 'any', 'creativeCommon'. Defaults to 'any'.

eventtype.description: The event type. Options are 'any', 'live'. Defaults to 'any'.

type.description: The event type. Options are 'any', 'live'. Defaults to 'any'.

order.description: The sorting order of the results. Options are 'relevance', 'date', 'viewCount', 'rating'. Defaults to 'relevance'.

videotype.description: The type of video. Options are 'any', 'episode', 'movie'. Defaults to 'any'.

tools.name: get_lexical_field
tools.description: Retrieves the lexical field for a given word using the Dicolink API.

mot.description: The word for which the lexical field is to be retrieved.

limite.description: The limit on the number of results to be retrieved (default is '20').

query: Compute the total cost of an order with items ['Shirt', 'Pants', 'Shoes'], quantities [1, 2, 1], and prices [25.99, 39.99, 59.99].

tools.name: get_ip_zipcode
tools.description: Retrieves the ZIP code of a given IP address using the ip-api.com API.

tools.name: get_dna_sequence
tools.description: Retrieves the DNA sequence for a given sequence ID from the NCBI Nucleotide database.

sequence_id.description: The unique identifier for the DNA sequence.

file_format.description: The format of the returned sequence. Allowed values: "fasta" (default) or "gb".

upstream_bases.description: The number of bases upstream of the sequence to include. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: is_valid_ip_address
tools.description: Checks if a string is a valid IP address (IPv4).

tools.name: calculate_order_total
tools.description: Calculates the total cost of an order based on the items, quantities, and prices.

quantities.description: A list of corresponding quantities for each item.

prices.description: A list of corresponding prices for each item.

tools.name: reserve_hotel_room
tools.description: Reserves a hotel room with the specified details.

room_type.description: The type of room to reserve.

nightly_rate.description: The nightly rate for the room.

checkin_date.description: The check-in date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

checkout_date.description: The check-out date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

guest_id.description: The unique identifier for the guest.

promo_code.description: A promotional code for a discount. Defaults to None.

query: Retrieve the public holidays in the UK for the year 2023.

tools.name: get_holidays_by_year
tools.description: Retrieves the list of public holidays for a given year and country using the Nager.Date API.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the holidays.

country_code.description: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

tools.name: get_dna_sequence
tools.description: Retrieves the DNA sequence for a given sequence ID from the NCBI Nucleotide database.

sequence_id.description: The unique identifier for the DNA sequence.

file_format.description: The format of the returned sequence. Allowed values: "fasta" (default) or "gb".

upstream_bases.description: The number of bases upstream of the sequence to include. Defaults to 0.
